name: iStreet Network Limited
about: iStreet Network Limited operates as an internet and retail catalogue company in India. The company offers various products, including IndyGen Labs, which shifts organizations from manual workflows and static scripts to intelligent systems; Heal, a platform that delivers full-stack observability, predictive analytics, and AI-led self-healing; Optimas, which enables enterprises to unify compliance, cyber-risk, and governance into a live, dynamic, and control framework; Quilr that protects business-critical files; 1Kosmos, which enables self-service identity verification and password less multi-factor authentication; Cyble that delivers threat intelligence; and Kaspersky, a security platform. It also provides digital solutions, such as application performance monitoring; artificial intelligence for IT operations; single sign-on; security token; threat intelligence; endpoint security; governance, risk, and compliance; human risk management; large language model security; microsegmentation; data loss prevention platforms; and security operations platforms. The company sells its products and services through its internet retail store, iStreet Bazaar. The company was formerly known as Principal Pharmaceuticals & Chemicals Limited and changed its name to iStreet Network Limited in April 2013. iStreet Network Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.
